hook.es: Los símbolos estaban ahí desde el principio.
hook.en: The symbols were there from the beginning.

objective: NØVA notices the recurring geometric symbols across every world visited so far and begins assembling them. First half of the cipher is revealed: YOU ARE NOT LOST.

metadata.thumbnail_concept: NØVA arranging glowing symbol fragments in the air, the partial cipher text barely visible: YOU ARE NOT LOST

notes: Theme: pattern recognition as a form of hope — the symbols were never random.
Emotional conflict: unease at not understanding the message's origin, alongside relief at its content.
Visual motif: pays off every symbol planted since Episode 1 (mask, chest emblem, architecture, water, code).
